To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the morphology in the metal interface is the key point for space charge initiation and propagation.
the morphology in the bulk and in the metal– dielectric interface is the main reason for space charge accumulation and propagation in LDPE.
the morphology of low density polyethylene has a significant effect on the charge injection and space charge characteristics.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of morphology on space charge characteristics in polyethylene films.
the space charge characteristics of LDPE samples with different morphologies, which is of importance for the development of polymeric materials for electrical insulation applications.
the space charge phenomena in polymers with different morphology and the influence of morphology on space charge.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the morphology of polymers plays an important role in the injection and propagation of space charge.
the morphologies in the metal–polymer interface and in the polymer bulk play a significant role on the space charge characteristics in LDPE.
the morphologies of LDPE samples play a significant role in the injection, transport and decay of space charge.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the morphology in the metal-dielectric interface and in bulk of polymers is convincingly suggested as responsible for the injection process and the propagation process of space charge.
space charge phenomena in polymers are strongly related to the morphological structure.
the morphology effects on space charge characteristics are mainly due to the morphology in the metal-dielectric interface and in bulk of polymers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the morphology of polymers is a key factor in the injection and propagation of space charge in polymers.
the morphology of the metal–dielectrics interface is the most important factor for space charge injection and propagation processes.
the space charge characteristics in LDPE films are strongly dependent on morphology.
